normalization: Internet Archive OCR text layers as fetched, uncorrected (text/<slug>.ocr.txt); the scan under original/<identifier>/ is the witness. Where the text layer is noise over a script (cuneiform, Avestan), the scan is the only reading.
scope: The Greek Corpus Hermeticum in the first critical edition (Parthey) and in Reitzenstein's texts, and the Asclepius in Latin, the only complete witness of the Perfect Discourse. Nock and Festugière's edition (1945–54) is in copyright and is not seated. The Coptic Hermetica of Nag Hammadi Codex VI (the Discourse on the Eighth and Ninth, the Prayer of Thanksgiving, the Asclepius excerpt) are already on the shelf in the Nag Hammadi seat. The Stobaean fragments: QUEUED.
verified_loci: Thomas 1908, the manuscripts of the Asclepius — 'Insunt: Asclepius et de deo'
why_seated: Asked for beside the Chaldaean Oracles, the Greek Magical Papyri and Nag Hammadi already seated: the Hermetic Poimandres, in which Nous shows the seer the making of the cosmos and the ascent through the seven spheres, is the Greek text of the archive's planetary seven.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-23: "detour for an ea-corpora searing. lets see. whats available of mayan texts? and then i dont think we have much or any deteurocanonical second temple lit - all those apocalypses. and what about the ethiopian canon? and euclid. all in original language or as close to it as possible. what else?" — "and the Egyptian book of the dead" — "and what about the fragments of the book of baalim? i might be miswriting this. recent discovery. if theyre available anywhere." — "yes yes yes to all - what a meal."
